set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-organization.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Freeze the synthetic organization recovery packets/estimands/tolerances before model comparisons; retain all failures and mutation-kill chronology enforcement and dropped unknowns. Synthetic success does not establish human recovery.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: recovery; lane: validation.

Scope: tools/recall-study recovery fixtures, docs preregistration

Acceptance criteria:
1. Commit known forward, reverse, jump and revisit packets with independent intended assignments; freeze admissible sets, grain, primary estimands, tolerances, seeds, missingness and aggregation before model comparisons.
2. Packet equivariance uses fixed IDs and packets, not resegmented shuffled text. Full language-pipeline reverse/revisit examples are authored coherently; source order/ID/chronology metadata perturbations reconcile.
3. Assess localization, candidate coverage, specificity and organization recovery bias, reversal sensitivity, group-effect attenuation and uncertainty/bounds coverage. At fixed true organization vary omissions, ambiguity, paraphrase and transcription quality.
4. Uniform/no-information evidence cannot produce a confident behavioral conclusion. Mutating to monotone paths, dropping unresolved units and counting projected word transitions each fails a known-answer witness.
5. All cases/failures remain in results. A negative result closes the executed study with a failed claim gate; tolerances are not loosened. Synthetic success does not establish human recovery.

Validation: proposed python3 tools/recall-study/recovery.py --frozen-manifest <path>; independent fixture oracle

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: No sealed participant gold read and no numeric human-accuracy promise.
